summary: Completed baseline reproduction for recurring long-video preview freeze context (no app fixes). Added reusable long-GOP media generator, backend proxy baseline pytest, and real-Chrome studio harness. Backend confirms <=720p H264 always skips proxy even on 185s long-GOP source; >720p triggers proxy generation.

minor.issue: Proxy decision skips all H264 where min(width,height)<=720 regardless of GOP structure or duration; long-GOP 185s 1280x720 returned proxy_id==media_id (no proxy transcode).

integration_issues.issue: Code-path probe shows startClipUpload has no ensureClipProxy call after mediaId assignment/completion (staticHasEnsure=false).

integration_issues.flow: Long clip scrub micro-seeks (backward and <=0.8s forward)
integration_issues.issue: wcScrubFrame immediate calls at [90, 89.4, 89.9, 90.45, 90.95, 90.2] returned no frame in baseline probe (all gotFrame=false), consistent with temporary preview stalls during scrub.

action_items: Wire ensureClipProxy invocation in normal upload flow once mediaId is assigned in startClipUpload (not only pre-existing mediaId branch).
Revisit proxy skip rule to include GOP/seekability heuristics, not only codec+<=720p resolution.
Investigate scrub path for fast backward/small-forward seeks where immediate frame availability is frequently null.
After fixes, rerun /app/frontend/tests/test_long_preview_baseline_chrome.py and /app/backend/tests/test_long_proxy_baseline_iter32.py for regression.
critical_code_review_comments: SegPlayer.fill() caps by frames.length and decodeQueueSize but not by pending-to-output backlog; baseline idle probe reached maxBuffered=30 despite cap logic, indicating queue overshoot risk after asynchronous decoder output.
Near EOF repeated seeks converged to same timestamp frameTsSec=184.875 with repeated flush cycles; behavior is deterministic but can manifest as apparent freeze near clip end in repeated seek loops.
studio.html remains very large (>6k lines), making targeted media pipeline regression harder and increasing risk of cross-feature coupling.
seed_data_creation: Generated local test media in /tmp/beatcut_long_assets (185s H264 long-GOP 1280x720 and 1280x800). Backend uploads created media IDs 6aa436ffbdb0f4a753cb499f and 6aa436ffbdb0f4a753cb49fe for this run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use existing assets via python /app/frontend/tests/generate_long_gop_assets.py. Backend regression already saved JUnit at /app/test_reports/pytest/iter32_long_proxy_backend.xml. Frontend baseline metrics are in /app/test_reports/frontend_long_preview_baseline_iter32.json (duration=185s, sampleCount=4440, seek metrics at 10/90/170/179, idle queue growth, EOF repeats, rapid-cut timings). Chrome binary verified at /usr/bin/google-chrome (Chromium 151).
rca of the issue: RCA baseline evidence: (1) upload path integration gap: startClipUpload does not call ensureClipProxy post-mediaId, so long clips rely on transcode swap and may never trigger preview proxy path automatically. (2) backend proxy policy skips all <=720p H264 regardless of long-GOP seek complexity, so difficult 720p long clips are kept as-is. (3) decoder pipeline: repeated EOF seeks return same terminal frame and fill/queue behavior can build sizeable buffered frame counts while decodeQueueSize appears capped, matching user perception of occasional stalls/freeze on long clips. Note: one integration probe used **MOCKED** API wiring only to validate call-path presence; core parse/seek metrics and backend proxy behavior used real media and real endpoints.
